messages:
danya: short sync 1 visibility console MVP decisions. need to lock what ships this sprint: overview dashboard (cost + errors), trace pointers (sampled), per-route cost estimates, and a tiny alerts panel.
owen: agree. biggest risk is customers expecting billing-grade numbers day 1. propose
 - heuristics day0 (path+model mapping) + 'estimated' badge
 - exact accounting only when `x-route-id` header present
rita: design: show confidence band and an info tooltip linking to migration guide. small UI, one dashboard with tabs.
samir: runtime: sampling defaults matter. suggest 0.3% baseline, trace-on-error for 5xx/timeout, and on-demand capture API. flag per-customer override.
lucy: CS: pilots want model-version splits and a simple link to request-id for support. they'll accept estimates if labeled and documented.
danya: draft launch gates pasted:
- Overview: top-15 routes by traffic and cost visible; panels render <2s P95
- Tracing: sampled quick-links + capture API implemented; default sample 0.3% + trace-on-error true
- Cost: heuristic per-route estimates with confidence badge; exact when `x-route-id` validated
- Errors: grouping & top fingerprints; quick jump to sampled trace
- Alerts: threshold alerts to webhook/email + simple ack/snooze
- Security: visibility restricted to account admins; audit logs on access
- Docs: migration + SDK snippet + pilot runbook validated by 2 customers
- SLOs: ingestion lag <6m P95, backfill for recent window <48h
metrics-bot: canary scheduled: visibility:v0.1 -> 2167890160 (owner: owen)
owen: blockers: need feature flag for sampling and simple header passthrough in ingress. I'll own canary and perf metrics. ETA Wed.
rita: I'll mock the confidence UI and the 'estimated' badge by Tue.
samir: infra ask: 48h raw trace retention + 30d rollups -> estimated infra +9%. need finance ok.
lucy: I'll coordinate two pilots and prepare comms + migration docs. ETA next Thu.
danya: decision: ship heuristics day0, default 0.3% sampling + trace-on-error, 48h retention, and per-customer sampling override behind a flag. thumbs-reactions?
owen: +1
rita: +1
samir: +1, will add feature.visibility.sampling_rate and feature.visibility.trace_on_error flags
lucy: +1 pending pilot alignment
danya: action items:
- owen: canary + perf metrics + sampling flag (ETA Wed)
- samir: retention cost estimate and infra changes (ETA Tue)
- rita: UI mocks + confidence badge (ETA Tue)
- lucy: pilot comms + migration docs (ETA Thu)
- danya: compile launch checklist and get finance loop (ETA Fri)
danya: thanks all. will post a short PR with gates and owners. :sparkles:
